resolutions.detail: Two predicates over text already read: (1) every `^def _band...` / `^def _check_published_band...` IN THE FILE must be inside the region — not a fixed list of three names, which said nothing about band code added later; (2) the closing marker must sit at a top-level boundary (first non-blank line after it is not indented). Membership is tested with a name built at runtime, so no literal in the region can satisfy it from within.
